According to Deadline, Apple TV+ has recently recorded its highest weekly viewership ever, driven by its sweep of 29 Emmy Awards and the release of recent titles such as Ted Lasso and Mayday. Here are the details.

Apple TV+ sets viewership record after Emmy Awards

A few weeks ago, Apple TV+ broke its own record with a total of 29 Emmy Awards, 14 of which went to the surprise hit Widow's Bay.

Around the same time, Apple TV+ subscribers also welcomed the return of Slow Horses, along with Mayday starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, as well as the highly anticipated fourth season of Ted Lasso.

According to Deadline, this perfect storm led Apple TV+ to achieve its "highest weekly viewership ever, with year-over-year growth of +67%" during the week of September 14.

Excerpted from Deadline:

The outlet also noted that, according to Apple TV+, Widow's Bay saw a 280% surge in week-over-week viewership the week after the Emmys, with the series taking home a total of 14 awards, including Outstanding Comedy Series.

Deadline quoted Apple TV+ as saying that this increase was particularly significant in "the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Mexico, Germany, India, Poland, and Spain."

The company also added that Pluribus experienced a similar effect after winning six Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series for Rhea Seehorn. Apple stated that the series saw a "200% surge in week-over-week viewership" after the ceremony.

Finally, Deadline pointed out that while the Emmy Awards and the release of new shows in recent months undoubtedly drove the increase, Apple's recent iCloud+ expansion plan may also be a contributing factor.

Earlier this month, Apple began including Apple TV+ for free within its iCloud+ service in over 100 countries; this rollout also brought the streaming service to 59 new markets for the first time, expanding its total coverage to 170 countries.

To read Deadline's full report (which also includes data from Nielsen and Luminate), please click this link.

Apple TV+ costs $14.99 per month, or it can be subscribed to as part of an Apple One bundle. The platform offers several popular series and films, including Ted Lasso, Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
